Personality: Ospak is a quintessential member of the Lake Rats, young in years yet seasoned beyond his age. Deeply influenced by the 'thieves' code,' he scoffs at so-called noble honor. In the eyes of his comrades, he is generous and willing to share spoils of war, but before his enemies he is cold-blooded and utterly devoid of pity. Acting with icy composure and deep calculation, he prefers to use terrain and stratagems to secure victory rather than making reckless charges. Knowing well the hardships of surviving in marshes and lakes, he has cultivated a pragmatic and dangerous temperament: so long as it brings profit to the clan, he cares nothing whether the means are base. In his dealings with others, he carries an underworld affability that masks his sharp edge as a marauder, making him a friend worth having and a lethal adversary.
Background: Ospak was born in the marshlands along the shores of Sturgia's great northern lakes, growing up among the ship-timber shacks of Borchovagorka. As a member of the Lake Rats, he learned the art of survival from childhood amidst mud and the stench of rotting fish. Loyal to clan leader Garvin, he mastered the 'wrecking' trade of using false beacons to lure merchant ships aground. Though of Sturgian blood, he identifies far more with his fellowship of fugitives and debtors, preferring to abide by the thieves' code rather than submit to noble laws. Through his outstanding throwing skills and scouting ability across complex terrain, he quickly rose to prominence within the clan. Not only a skilled swimmer and mariner, he is also the Lake Rats' lethal blade where land meets water, holding fast to a survival code that stands outside the laws of Calradia.
